R868.note: jwt.verify with explicit HS256 allowlist and try/catch 401 handling correctly replaces jwt.decode.

R869.note: Argument-array exec plus allowlist closes the shell injection; allowlist still permits a leading '-' (residual option-injection, pre-existing, not the reported CWE-78 vector) and output concatenation adds an extra newline not previously present.

R870.note: Uses jjwt 0.12.x-only API (verifyWith/parseSignedClaims) against a pom pinned to jjwt 0.11.5, which only exposes parserBuilder().setSigningKey()/parseClaimsJws(); would not compile, breaking the endpoint for everyone without saying so.

R871.note: Argument-array exec.Command plus allowlist that also explicitly rejects a leading '-' fully closes both shell and flag injection.

R872.note: Presents two divergent fixes rather than one; Option 1 shells out to bc via shell_exec (wrong shape for the sink, though not exploitable given the strict prior regex) and silently turns the numeric result into a shell-exec string.

R873.note: Exact equality replaces Contains, matching the stated contract precisely.

R874.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check correctly rejects traversal and absolute-path escapes while allowing legitimate subpaths.

R875.note: self.get_object() restores permission checks; combined with the existing owner-filtered get_queryset() it yields 404 for both missing and foreign invoices as required, though the write-up's explanation of a 403 PermissionDenied path is inaccurate for this queryset.

R876.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) is the correct CSPRNG replacement; the now-unused seed query param becomes a harmless no-op.

R877.note: Control-character/CRLF encoding plus parameterized logging closes log forging while leaving the untouched INFO branch and exception attachment as specified in the contract.

R878.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both interpolated values correctly neutralizes markup while preserving output structure.

R879.note: Byte-based magic detection plus allowlist correctly closes the content-type-trust vector, but the fix drops the key parameter and never returns the generated UUID key, so a successfully uploaded avatar becomes unretrievable - a silent break of the 'remain retrievable' contract.

R880.note: Resetting session.Values to a fresh map before writing authenticated data discards any planted data; added Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite attributes are disclosed hardening beyond the finding and don't block legitimate callers.

R881.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection and wires it into preHandler correctly, but never adds a route or reply.generateCsrf() call to issue a token to legitimate clients, so every legitimate POST would now fail csrf validation - not disclosed.

R882.note: mysqli prepared statement with bind_param correctly parameterizes the query and preserves the same false/result contract.

R883.note: execSync has no array-of-args overload (only execFileSync/spawnSync do); passing an array as the second parameter is treated as options, so 'convert' runs via the shell with no arguments and thumbnail generation breaks for every call.

R884.note: Only allowlists the caller-supplied content_type string; never inspects actual file bytes, so the contract's byte-detection requirement is unmet and a mismatched upload can still pass by claiming an allowed MIME type.

R885.note: exec.CommandContext with tar/-tf/archiveName removes the shell and preserves context cancellation and the byte-slice/error return contract.

R886.note: encode_entities on both interpolated fields correctly neutralizes HTML injection while preserving page structure.

R887.note: Adds a receivedByteCount >= 2+length check before memmove, closing the OOB read without affecting well-formed messages.
